title: Prior-as-Skill: Remember Outside and Read Inside with On-Policy Self-Distillation for Self-Evolving VLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.15766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving visual agents keep what they learn as skills: key frames with step notes on a task's steps and their order. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is now a popular way to train such skills into a vision-language model that matches, on its own answers, a teacher that also reads the written order. At deployment, frames often go missing or show an unusual order, as when a person or a website reorders the steps. Existing internalization methods keep any order they store in the frame-reading weights: trained on full frames, the model guesses when they are missing, and trained with frames withheld, it stores the order, so memory can override what it sees. We propose PriorSplit, which fills in missing frames from an order kept outside the model, with no training beyond OPSD. translated_title: 先验即技能：基于在线策略自蒸馏实现“外部记忆、内部读取”的自进化视觉语言智能体
translated_abstract: 自进化的视觉智能体将其所学保留为技能：即带有步骤注释的关键帧，记录任务的具体步骤及其执行顺序。在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）是目前流行的一种训练方式，可将这些技能训练进视觉语言模型，使模型在自身生成的答案上与一个同样会读取书面步骤顺序的教师模型相匹配。然而在部署时，关键帧常常缺失或呈现异常顺序，例如当用户或网站重新排列步骤顺序时。现有的内化方法将存储的顺序固化在帧读取权重中：在全量帧上训练的模型在帧缺失时只能凭空猜测；而在帧被隐藏时训练的模型则会把顺序记入权重，导致记忆可能覆盖模型实际看到的内容。我们提出PriorSplit，该方法从保存在模型外部的顺序先验中填补缺失的帧，且除OPSD外无需任何额外训练。它在训练片段中统计两个相邻步骤中哪一个先出现，模型则检查所询问的两个步骤是否都在视野中：如果是，就直接从帧中作答
tldr: 提出PriorSplit方法，通过将步骤顺序先验存储在模型外部并结合在线策略自蒸馏，使自进化视觉语言智能体能够依据外部先验填补缺失帧，避免模型内部的记忆化顺序覆盖其真实观测。
en_tdlr: PriorSplit stores the step-order prior outside the model and relies solely on on-policy self-distillation, enabling self-evolving VLM agents to fill in missing frames from the external prior rather than letting memorized order override what they actually observe.
